require "json"

def randn(n : Int32? = nil)
  theta = 2.0 * Math::PI * rand
  rho = Math.sqrt(-2.0 * Math.log(1.0 - rand))
  value = rho * Math.cos(theta)
  if n
    Array.new(n) { randn }
  else
    value
  end
end

class KANQuantum
  property dim : Int32 = 9216
  property grid : Int32 = 5
  property spline_coeffs : Array(Array(Float64))
  def initialize
    @spline_coeffs = (0...@dim).map do
      (0...@grid).map { rand - 0.5 }
    end
  end
  def interpolate(x : Float64, coeffs : Array(Float64)) : Float64
    knots = (0...@grid).map { |i| i.to_f / (@grid - 1).to_f }
    basis = b_spline_basis(x, knots, 3)
    sum_index = 0.0
    basis.each_with_index do |b, i|
      sum_index += b * coeffs[i % coeffs.size]
    end
    sum_index
  end
  def b_spline_basis(x : Float64, knots : Array(Float64), degree : Int32) : Array(Float64)
    if degree == 0
      knots.each_with_index.map do |k, i|
        limit = i + 1 < knots.size ? knots[i + 1] : 1.0
        (x >= k && x < limit) ? 1.0 : 0.0
      end
    else
      left_knots = knots[0, knots.size - 1]
      right_knots = knots[1, knots.size - 1]
      left = b_spline_basis(x, left_knots, degree - 1)
      right = b_spline_basis(x, right_knots, degree - 1)
      result = Array.new(left.size, 0.0)
      left.each_with_index do |lv, i|
        denom = left_knots[i + degree] - left_knots[i]
        a = denom.abs > 1e-12 ? (x - left_knots[i]) / denom : 0.0
        result[i] += a * lv
      end
      right.each_with_index do |rv, i|
        denom = right_knots[i + degree] - right_knots[i]
        b = denom.abs > 1e-12 ? (right_knots[i + degree] - x) / denom : 0.0
        result[i] += b * rv
      end
      result
    end
  end
  def forward(input : Array(Float64)) : Array(Float64)
    input.map_with_index do |x, i|
      coeffs = @spline_coeffs[i % @dim]
      interpolate((x % 1.0).abs, coeffs)
    end
  end
end
def spectral_regulate(tensor, target)
  mean = tensor.sum / tensor.size
  variance = tensor.map { |x| (x - mean) ** 2 }.sum / tensor.size
  std = Math.sqrt(variance)
  if std.nan?
    tensor.map { |x| x }
  else
    scale = target / (std + 1e-12)
    tensor.map { |x| (x - mean) * scale + mean }
  end
end
def tgn_update(nodes, memory, time_m, sparsity, bits, grid)
  bs = nodes.size
  nf = nodes[0].size
  updated = Array.new(bs) { Array.new(nf, 0.0) }
  (0...bs).each do |b|
    (0...nf).each do |f|
      time_val = time_m[b % time_m.size]
      time_scalar = time_val.is_a?(Array) ? (time_val[0]? || 0.0) : time_val
      gate = Math.tanh(nodes[b][f] + memory[b][f % memory[b].size] * 0.01 + time_scalar * 0.001)
      if rand < sparsity
        updated[b][f] = (gate * 2 - 1) * (2 ** bits - 1) / (2 ** bits)
      else
        updated[b][f] = gate
      end
    end
  end
  updated
end
def main
  bs = 64
  nf = 8192
  nodes = Array.new(bs) { Array.new(nf) { randn } }
  memory = Array.new(bs) { Array.new(8192) { randn } }
  time_m = Array.new(bs) { randn(512) rescue Array.new(512) { randn } }
  updated = tgn_update(nodes, memory, time_m, 0.98, 3, 5)
  puts "Advanced KAN TGN updated shape: #{updated.size} x #{updated[0].size}"
  regulated = spectral_regulate(updated.flatten, 0.9999)
  puts "Spectral regulated length: #{regulated.size}"
end
if __FILE__ == $0
  main
end
